title: The Singularity Is Near
subtitle: When Humans Transcend Biology
pitch: The optimist's bible: technology grows exponentially, human level AI arrives around 2029 and a singularity merges humans and machines by 2045.

chapters.g: Kurzweil's big history of information: physics, biology, brains, technology, the merger of human and machine, and the universe waking up.

chapters.t: A theory of technology evolution: the law of accelerating returns
chapters.g: His core claim: the rate of progress itself speeds up, so change is exponential, not linear.

chapters.t: Achieving the computational capacity of the human brain
chapters.g: Estimates of how much computing the brain does, and when cheap hardware will match it.

chapters.t: Achieving the software of human intelligence: how to reverse engineer the human brain
chapters.g: How brain scanning and modelling could give us the software of intelligence.
Genetics, nanotechnology and robotics (which for him includes AI), each building on the last.
What the singularity would do to the body, the brain, work, war, learning and our place in the cosmos.
What it means to believe in the singularity, and his personal outlook.

chapters.t: The deeply intertwined promise and peril of GNR
chapters.g: Kurzweil does take risks seriously here, including misuse of biotech and nanotech and unfriendly AI, and suggests defences.
Replies to many objections, from 'exponentials always stop' to 'computers cannot be conscious'.
A closing reflection on how far this might go.

ideas: Progress is exponential because technology helps build better technology.
A singularity around 2045 where humans merge with AI.

args.a: Exponential trends will continue until the singularity.
args.c: Many exponentials turn into S curves. Critics say Kurzweil picks trends that fit.

args.a: Merging with AI keeps humans in the loop.
args.c: Safety researchers worry that merging does not solve alignment and may come too late.

questions: Kurzweil predicted human level AI by 2029. How does that look from where you sit?
Is the law of accelerating returns a law or a pattern?
Would you want to merge with AI?

quiz.q: What year does Kurzweil give for the singularity?
quiz.w: He gives 2029 for human level AI and 2045 for the singularity.
Robotics in his use includes strong AI.

quiz.q: The law of accelerating returns says...
o: The rate of technological progress speeds up
quiz.w: Each generation of technology helps build the next faster.
